definitions.development: 27 existing synthetic cells, first 10 saved paired repetitions. Known development evidence, not held-out data.
definitions.optimism: A fixed-count one-sided 90% Clopper-Pearson upper bound and optimistic program lifetime. Not a time-uniform confidence or regret guarantee.
definitions.quality: Detected-failure quality is protected by the inherited simulator construction. No live quality claim.
definitions.robustness: Also report ratios to best fixed and all eight original online baselines. Agent safety alone does not satisfy near-optimality.
definitions.safety: Prefix pure-token cost <= (1+epsilon) sum(c_f+tau0), conditional on the supplied deterministic cost profiles. Hidden penalty is excluded.
definitions.scope: Exploratory protocol research only. No paper writes, new model calls, or changes to old results.
definitions.selection: All ten predefined candidates and all eight original baselines are retained. No winner is silently selected or tuned on validation.
definitions.top_two: Rank by distinct mean costs, treating differences <=1e-9 of baseline cost as numerical ties. Report near-best 5/10/25% coverage separately.
definitions.validation_grid: 300 fresh scenario cells. Gate probabilities are assigned independently of cost profiles; no original admission flags are exposed to policies.
definitions.validation_real: 12 fresh mapping/outcome settings on existing real-log sequences. New realizations, not independent newly collected logs.
